# iCliniq

> iCliniq is a 24/7 AI-powered telemedicine platform connecting patients with 4500+ doctors across 80+ medical specialties globally for instant online consultations.

iCliniq provides multiple consultation channels including text chat, phone, and video consultations with board-certified physicians. The platform serves patients in India, the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, and beyond, combining expert medical advice with health education resources.

## Core Consultation Services

- [Ask a Doctor Online | Get your Medical Questions Answered](https://www.icliniq.com/ask-a-doctor-online): Main platform for online doctor consultations across 80+ specialties with 4500+ doctors globally.
- [Video Chat with a Doctor | Talk with a Doctor on Video Chat](https://www.icliniq.com/video-chat-with-doctor): Face-to-face video consultation service with multi-specialty doctors for instant medical advice.
- [iCliniq: Get a Doctor Call-Back | Talk with a Doctor on the Phone](https://www.icliniq.com/phone-a-doctor): Phone consultation service with doctors from 80+ specialties for instant medical advice.
- [Chat with a Doctor #icliniq100hrs (icliniq 100 hours)](https://www.icliniq.com/ask-a-doctor-online/icq100): Live chat subscription service for instant medical advice and expert answers from doctors.

## Medical Specialties

- [Ask an Obstetrician And Gynecologist Online](https://www.icliniq.com/ask-a-doctor-online/obstetrician-and-gynecologist): Consult experienced obstetrician-gynecologists online for pregnancy care and women's health advice.
- [Health Questions and Answers sorted by Medical Specialties](https://www.icliniq.com/qa/specialities): Browse thousands of health Q&A sorted by medical specialties for self-education.
